<solution_file path="src/t02_load_eurostat.py">
import pandas as pd

# Load selected indicators
selected_indicators = pd.read_csv('outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv')

# Load Eurostat city values
eurostat_city_values = pd.read_csv('inputs/eurostat/eurostat_city_values_sample.csv')

# Filter selected indicators from Eurostat city values
eurostat_raw = eurostat_city_values[
    eurostat_city_values['indicator_id'].isin(selected_indicators['indicator_id'])
].copy()

# Drop duplicate rows
eurostat_raw.drop_duplicates(subset=['city_id', 'year', 'indicator_id'], keep='first', inplace=True)

# Reorder columns to match the output format
eurostat_raw = eurostat_raw[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', 'indicator_id', 'indicator_name', 'value', 'unit']]

# Write the output
eurostat_raw.to_csv('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv', index=False, quotechar='"', doublequote=True, escapechar='\\')
</solution_file>
